Open Call for Scores
Season by season, since 2013

The composers.

Each year, CreArtBox holds a Call for Scores, selecting works to perform the following season. Past selections can lead to new collaborations and repeat performances, and previously selected composers may apply again free of charge.

The composers below include past selections and invited guests, identified individually. Four resident composers are listed first.

Submit to the current call →
